assign.outcome:
**The paging hub lands: four mechanisms, five styles, two size axes, one toolbar — and every mechanism proved at 1280 and 3440.**

[/imagine/paging/](/imagine/paging/) is the stage: three lines of what it is, then THE WALK — five stops, each hop made with the mechanism at its end, each landing on a different surface — then the card wall.

**One class, three parts.** `paging.js` — `Paging extends Page`, with `Paging.Toolbar` (the mode chips, remembered by `store()` against the page's url), `Paging.Item` (a child row carrying its mechanism's icon at the end) and `Paging.Code` (the `route("code")` child: the page's own module fetched from `import.meta.url`, plus the calls your chips make, appended LIVE in the column beside them). Every method a seam; the walk, the four-mechanism page and the from/by/to labels are all overrides, no new config keys.

**Two of the four mechanisms are core's columns words, not new machinery.** `launch` is a child column; `takeover` is `width: "full"`. `expand` and `swap` never navigate. A child's track is its PARENT's mechanism — one set of children, and the chip decides whether clicking one opens a column beside it or collapses the row into it.

**Proved, headless, at both widths** ([the numbers](/imagine/paging/doc/mechanisms.md)):

| | 1280 | 3440 |
|---|---|---|
| `launch` | columns 4 → 5, parent unchanged | 4 → 5, parent gave 76px to the row |
| `expand` | columns 4 → 4, panel opens under the item | same |
| `swap` | box `dx 0, dy 0`, content changed | `dx 0, dy 0` |
| `takeover` | `[211,535,535]` → `[1280]`, crumbs 3 → 4 | `[432,1152,1152]` → `[3440]` |

![takeover at 1280, before](shots/takeover-1280-before.png)
![takeover at 1280, after](shots/takeover-1280-after.png)

**Two bugs found by measuring, not by thinking.** The layout axis silently undid a declared `width: "full"` — takeover rendered as a 241px column instead of the whole row, nothing thrown; the axis default is now DERIVED from the page's own width word. And a chip wearing `<button>` came out as an uppercase CTA: `.theme-lew42 :is(button, .btn)` is (0,2,0) in the same layer and wins whatever a component says — a clickable span is the fix the styles docs already reached.

**Zero console errors** at 400 / 1280 / 1920 / 3440 on the hub and all four factor pages, zero horizontal overflow, and all 20 content × layout combinations clicked in one run with none.

**Eight of eight deliverables landed**, `transitions/` included — it is a picker (from · by · to), not a 100-cell matrix.

**Left:** the mechanism chips are deliberately absent from the hub (a sticky full-screen child would outlive the visit) · a mode is `localStorage` per url, so a look you like is not yet a link you can send · toolbar PLACEMENT (top/left/right/bottom × inside/outside) is wave 2 · the four sibling realms (`rightnav/ explorer/ inventory/ critique/`) all have a `page.js` on disk and are ready for the mastermind to name in the hub's `children:` — the comment marking the spot is in `page.js`.
